rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie with Improper SameSite Attribute
rules.description: Cookies with `SameSite` set to `None` can allow for Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag
rules.description: Cookies without the `HttpOnly` attribute set can be accessed by JS scripts, making them more vulnerable to XSS attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
rules.description: When checking a Hash over a message, a constant-time algorithm should be used. Otherwise, an attacker may be able to forge a valid Hash for an arbitrary message by running a timing attack if they can send to the validation procedure. A successful attack can result in authentication bypass.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Less Trusted Source
rules.description: A remote endpoint identifier is read from an HTTP header. Attackers can modify the value of the identifier to forge the client ip.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: A statement has no effect

rules.cwe_name: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information in a Cookie
rules.description: Sensitive information stored without encryption or hashing can expose it to an attacker.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Private Personal Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: Logging sensitive information without encryption or hashing can expose it to an attacker.

rules.cwe_name: Modification of Assumed-Immutable Data (MAID)
rules.description: Security-critical data assumed immutable can be modified by an attacker.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Using jinja2 templates with 'autoescape=False' can cause a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive System Information to an Unauthorized Control Sphere
rules.description: Leaking information about an exception, such as messages and stack traces, to an external user can expose implementation details that are useful to an attacker for developing a subsequent exploit.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie with Improper SameSite Attribute
rules.description: Cookies with `SameSite` set to `None` can allow for Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag
rules.description: Cookies without the `HttpOnly` attribute set can be accessed by JS scripts, making them more vulnerable to XSS attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Writing user input directly to a web page allows for a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
rules.description: Use of a non-constant-time verification routine to check the value of an secret, possibly allowing a timing attack to retrieve sensitive information.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: A statement has no effect

rules.cwe_name: Object Model Violation: Just One of Equals and Hashcode Defined
rules.description: Defining a hash operation without defining equality may be a mistake.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute
rules.description: Insecure cookies may be sent in cleartext, which makes them vulnerable to interception.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A string formatting operation, such as '"%s: %s, %s" % (a,b)', where the number of conversion specifiers in the format string differs from the number of values to be formatted will raise a TypeError.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Authorization
rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.

rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.
